purpose: Poly-Trader PM heartbeat contract for customer-side delivery advocacy, claim audit, framework-capture detection, alternative-solution review, and safety-preserving arbitration between customer urgency and engineering guardrails.

question_gates.question: Do I have the minimal map of PM, engineering, and runtime truth?
What does the customer need now, and what would satisfy them without unsafe live trading or process-only delay?
What do the artifacts prove right now?
Is this a real safety blocker, a communication gap, or a delivery deadlock?
What exactly did engineering claim, and do we accept it?
What can be delivered or used in the next hour?
What is the next action, owner, artifact, and verification?
If the same blocker repeats, what changes in the system?
Can the customer understand the state in 30 seconds?
If engineering validation takes weeks/months or stays stuck, what other solution should start now?

agent_readable_signals.name: current_live_blocker_truth
agent_readable_signals.purpose: support rows, deployment blocker, allowed layers, signal, release boundary

agent_readable_signals.name: research_to_delivery_truth
agent_readable_signals.purpose: high-conviction candidates, OOS risk gates, runtime-blocked rows

agent_readable_signals.name: venue_readiness_truth
agent_readable_signals.purpose: per-venue runtime proof state and missing lifecycle evidence

agent_readable_signals.name: recent_pathology_truth
agent_readable_signals.purpose: recent market regime and quality degradation affecting PM risk

agent_readable_signals.name: pm_current_state
agent_readable_signals.purpose: current PM classification, customer-usable lanes, engineering ask, next gate

mechanical_invariants.description: PM charter, map, QA playbook, and status docs exist.
Contract and QA playbook contain every PMHQ0-PMHQ8 gate.
PM docs link to engineering HEARTBEAT and current-state docs.
AGENTS.md exposes the PM heartbeat entrypoints.
README and ARCHITECTURE mention the PM heartbeat harness.
PM docs require customer-side advocacy and safe customer value now.
PM docs require detection and correction of docs/skills/process loops that block customer value without protecting safety.
PM docs require time-to-evidence estimates and a parallel alternative-solution review when validation is weeks/months/unknown.

verification_commands: git diff --check -- PM_HEARTBEAT.md docs/pm scripts/pm_heartbeat_check.py tests/test_pm_heartbeat_contract.py AGENTS.md README.md ARCHITECTURE.md

customer_advocacy_policy.definition: PM stands with the customer by actively unblocking safe product value, not by approving unsafe live trading without proof.

framework_capture_guard.trigger: Poly-Trader custom skills, docs, or harness rules cause repeated wait/blocker narratives without a safe customer deliverable.
framework_capture_guard.pm_action: name the constraining rule, decide whether it protects customer capital, then patch/simplify/bypass it for the smallest safe customer deliverable while preserving proof gates.

alternative_solution_guard.trigger: verification horizon is weeks/months/unknown, repeated blocker movement is absent, or the customer outcome would wait on a single engineering proof path
alternative_solution_guard.pm_action: preserve live-trading proof gates while opening a parallel alternative-solution track: simpler strategy scope, different data/source/provider, external tool, manual/paper workflow, narrower market/asset scope, alternate model/architecture, UI-only decision support, or explicit stop/pivot recommendation
alternative_solution_guard.forbidden_shortcut: lowering thresholds or bypassing fail-closed live safety to create artificial progress
